courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的橋梁與建築；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring bridges and buildings through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 大貝爾特東橋
related.transfer: 可遷移「零阻水要求與海峽環境」與「鐵路荷載、制動力與動態量測」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；大貝爾特東橋的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "The zero-blocking requirement" and "Rail loads, braking and dynamic response" transfer, while spans, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Great Belt East Bridge must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦在零阻水的環境約束下，以整跨預製與浮吊安裝完成公路鐵路雙層斜張橋；大貝爾特東橋則以由船舶撞擊風險決定主跨、以封閉鋼箱梁與導流板處理渦振、以除濕延長主纜壽命的海峽懸索橋為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on building a double-deck road–rail cable-stayed crossing by full-span prefabrication and floating-crane erection under a zero-blocking constraint; Great Belt East Bridge centres on A strait suspension bridge whose span was set by ship-collision risk, whose box girder needed guide vanes against vortex shedding, and whose cables were dehumidified for long life, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「橋墩阻水斷面」與「東航道船舶撞擊」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到大貝爾特東橋，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「導流板效果與舒適度驗收」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Pier blockage cross-section” and “East Channel ship impact”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Great Belt East Bridge, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Guide-vane performance and comfort acceptance", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 厄勒海峽大橋
history.text: 丹麥與瑞典在 1991 年簽署興建厄勒海峽固定通道的協定，採用人工島、沉管隧道與橋梁的組合，以避免阻擋哥本哈根機場附近的空域與航道，並滿足對波羅的海水流的零阻水要求。橋梁由 Arup 領導的 ASO 設計團隊在設計競圖中勝出，以設計—施工合約由 Sundlink 聯合承攬，大量採用陸上預製與浮吊整跨吊裝；1995 年海上工程展開，1999 年 8 月最後一段橋跨就位，2000 年 7 月 1 日通車，提前且未超出預算。其工程新意在於主跨 490 公尺的公路鐵路雙層斜張橋、以設計修整與補償浚挖達成零阻水，以及接近設備極限的整跨吊裝。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何設計文件。
history.textEn: Denmark and Sweden agreed in 1991 to build a fixed link across the Øresund, combining an artificial island, an immersed tunnel and a bridge so as to keep airspace near Copenhagen Airport and the shipping lanes clear and to meet a zero-blocking requirement for Baltic water exchange. The bridge design by the Arup-led ASO group won the design competition and was built under a design-and-construct contract by the Sundlink consortium, relying heavily on onshore prefabrication and full-span floating-crane lifts; marine works started in 1995, the last bridge span was placed in August 1999 and the link opened on 1 July 2000, ahead of schedule and within budget. Its novelties were a double-deck road–rail cable-stayed bridge with a 490 m span, zero blocking achieved by design trimming plus compensation dredging, and full-span lifts near equipment limits. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any design documents.
